definitions.explanation: Fundamentally different in quality or nature from what surrounds it or from what is expected. Used to describe things, ideas, or people that do not fit in with the rest.

examples.japanese: {異質|いしつ}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{目立|めだ}っていた→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: It stood out as something fundamentally different.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異質|いしつ}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This work has a distinctly different atmosphere from his other novels.

examples.japanese: {異質|いしつ}な⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{多様性|たようせい}→多様性：04825_tayousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不可欠|ふかけつ}→不可欠：07027_fukaketsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Accepting fundamentally different cultures is not easy, but it is indispensable for a society that values diversity.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective ({異質|いしつ}な) or noun. Describes something that is qualitatively different from its surroundings or from what is expected. Can be neutral or carry a slightly negative nuance of not fitting in. The antonym is {同質|どうしつ} (homogeneous).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異質|いしつ}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (alien presence, something that doesn't fit)
- {異質|いしつ}な⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (fundamentally different culture)
- {異質|いしつ}なもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (exclude what is different)
- {異質|いしつ}{性|せい} (heterogeneity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同質|どうしつ}: homogeneous (antonym)
- ⟦{異様|いよう}→異様：13550_iyou⟧: bizarre, strange (more about appearance or atmosphere)
- ⟦{異種|いしゅ}→異種：20480_ishu⟧: different kind, different species (categorically different)
